articles.headline: MyDecisive Sharpens GitOps Observability and Opens Telemetry Stack This Week
articles.dek: MyDecisive announced tighter GitOps observability and released its telemetry components as open source.

body.text: Key Takeaway

MyDecisive upgraded its GitOps observability layer and pushed the telemetry stack to open source, giving platform teams immediate visibility into deployment pipelines [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
Why This Matters

For platform engineers, built‑in observability means you can trace changes from commit to cluster without stitching together third‑party tools, cutting mean‑time‑to‑detect on incidents [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
What Happened
On Aug 1 2026 MyDecisive released v2.4 of its GitOps suite, adding native metrics exporters and publishing the telemetry code under the Apache 2.0 license [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
Builder View

If you already run MyDecisive’s GitOps controller, drop the new observability plugin into your existing CI/CD namespace and point Prometheus at the new /metrics endpoint – no config churn, just immediate dashboards [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
Ardur Take
One source confirms the upgrade; treat the change as production‑ready but monitor community feedback for early bugs [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].

keyPoints: MyDecisive’s GitOps observability layer now exports native Prometheus metrics [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
The telemetry stack has been open‑sourced under Apache 2.0, enabling custom instrumentation [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
Version 2.4 ships with a plug‑and‑play plugin that integrates with existing CI/CD pipelines [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
articles.whyItMatters: Built‑in observability shortens troubleshooting cycles, which directly boosts reliability of platform services [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
articles.readerAction: Pull the v2.4 release from MyDecisive’s GitHub, enable the observability plugin, and add the new metrics endpoint to your monitoring stack [FACT:7d173b1c6a8fcba906d6bd8d8bcdce32].
